Nice Food but Pricey for what you get
May 2018 • Family
Went here last evening four of us to celebrate my youngest daughter’s 15th birthday. Booked a table inside the air-conditioned room as it was noisy outside with the band playing but the tables and stool-chairs were quite high and slightly uncomfortable.

Ordered drinks and a Special Meat Lover’s Combo that stated on the menu that it was good for 4-6 persons. After about 15 minutes the food arrived and first impressions were that the food was only good for 4 persons and we started to eat. But it became evident halfway through that the quantity of food would be insufficient for us, so we ended up ordering another but smaller platter afterwards.

The food tasted ok but given the quantity of items some of it was not so hot but when the second platter arrived the food was much hotter.

All in all it was a nice experience but we felt that the quantity of food for the 4-6 persons platter could have been improved upon.

Good, but not great (3.5 stars)
Apr 2018 • Friends
I ate here on a Monday night with a friend and came away with these impressions

The good: (1) friendly and attentive staff (2) The general quality of the food was good, especially the beef ribs; the salad with salmon was decent, but lacked something (a bit more dressing, perhaps). On the other hand, the sauces they give us with the meats were very good; (3) good atmosphere with bossa nova and latin music being played in the background, but not loudly.

The not so good: (1) bacon wasn't cooked fully; (2) If you've been to Quan Ut Ut, the portions here seem quite a bit smaller at BOC; very few chips (thick fries) included with the combo platter (3) there are no free flowing soft drinks. (4) Location: if you're in the Bui Vien or Nguyen Hue areas you'll need a taxi to get there, as the restaurant is located at the other end of district 1. (5) seating is uncomfortable, which might be a problem if you're over 1.75 (5'9")

Note that they are not open for lunch.
